tools.name: find_buying_guides
tools.description: Find KR/US buying guides by keywords and destination. Returns dated comparisons, exact product references and cited FAQ answers; an unsupported question is not a product fact. Use find_purchase_candidates for the buyer's chosen constraints.

tools.name: find_purchase_candidates
tools.description: Find exact products with issued affiliate routes. Requires query, destinationCountry and currency; preserve option, quantity, region, budget and benefits. Use responseMode brief. Returned URLs are not current stock or checkout.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search merchant catalogs by keywords or exact identifiers. Set affiliateLinkedOnly=true for recorded issued links. Use find_purchase_candidates with buyer destination and currency for a purchase route.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read one exact productId: dated native price, option and source evidence, original issued purchase URL. IDs come from returned products; a merchant URL or variant ID is not a productId.

tools.name: prepare_purchase
tools.description: Prepare an exact buyer-selected purchase handoff from dated records. Requires items and actual destinationCountry; US requires destinationRegion. Preserve variant, quantity, budget and benefits. Returns original issued URL and browser-agent steps. Never treats a yes to preparation as payment authori
